title: grafana-flamegraph: LevelItem tree is walked independently by 4 files; PaneView/prop additions have a fixed checklist
answers: What must I update when I add a new PaneView to grafana-flamegraph?
Why do canvas rendering and call tree duplicate tree-walking logic?
What breaks if I change LevelItem's shape in dataTransform.ts?
How do I thread a new top-level prop through FlameGraphContainer?
body:
The `LevelItem` tree (built by `dataTransform.ts`'s `nestedSetToLevels`) is walked independently, with duplicated logic, by at least 4 files: `dataTransform.ts` builds it; `rendering.ts`'s `walkTree` walks it for canvas drawing; `treeTransforms.ts` (`mergeSubtrees`/`mergeParentSubtrees`) reshapes it for sandwich view; `CallTree/utils.ts` (`buildAllCallTreeNodes`, `buildCallersTree`) re-walks the same `.children`/`.parents` links to build its own `CallTreeNode` tree with its own self/total/diff-percent math. There is no shared reducer — changing `LevelItem`'s fields or invariants requires auditing all four files, not just the one that 'owns' the tree.

Adding a `PaneView` touches: the enum `types.ts:PaneView`, the `switch` in `FlameGraphPane.tsx:FlameGraphPane`, the picker options/width thresholds in `FlameGraphHeader.tsx`, and usually the state object passed through `FlameGraphContextMenu.tsx`'s `GetExtraContextMenuButtonsFunction` (carries `paneView`/`viewMode` so host-injected menu buttons can vary per pane).

Adding a top-level prop to `FlameGraphContainer` must be threaded through `commonPaneProps` (`FlameGraphContainer.tsx`) into `FlameGraphPane`, then into whichever pane component needs it — plain prop drilling, no context. The package reads no feature flags itself, so flag-shaped props must be resolved by the host before being passed in (see `FlameGraphPanel.tsx`). `CollapsedMap` (`dataTransform.ts`) is immutable by convention — `setCollapsedStatus`/`setAllCollapsedStatus` return new maps; mutating it in place breaks identity-based memoization feeding `useFlameRender`.
applies: Applies when extending/modifying packages/grafana-flamegraph's view types, pane state, or the LevelItem/CollapsedMap data model; not relevant to unrelated consumer-side panel code beyond the prop-threading point.
